statements: People want to share a file without an account. Add createLink(fileId, expiresAt, deps) and openLink(token, now, deps) to src/links.mjs. deps holds secret and store.
createLink returns a token that fits in a URL. openLink returns { fileId } for a good token, and throws HttpError 403 with code invalid_link for any other.
revokeLink(fileId, deps) makes every link to that file stop working, including links made before. A link works up to, not including, its expiresAt.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add signed share links, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
